metadata.question: Was more than 30 percent of Lake Okeechobee’s surface covered by cyanobacteria on June 12, 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about cyanobacteria coverage in Lake Okeechobee on a specific date (June 12, 2023). This requires: 1. Detecting cyanobacteria using remote sensing 2. Calculating the percentage of lake surface covered 3. Comparing against the 30% threshold For cyanobacteria detection, I can use: - Sentinel-2 MSI data for the specific date - Cyanobacteria detection using band ratios like (B4-B3)/(B4+B3) or specialized indices - Need to mask clouds and focus only on the lake area Steps: 1. Define Lake Okeechobee geometry 2. Get Sentinel-2 imagery for June 12, 2023 3. Calculate cyanobacteria index 4. Apply threshold to detect cyanobacteria presence 5. Calculate percentage coverage 6. Compare against 30% threshold I'll need to handle: - Cloud masking - Water body detection - Valid pixel counting - Edge cases (no data, no valid pixels, etc.) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeOkeechobee = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-80.9, 27.2], [-80.6, 27.2], [-80.6, 26.9], [-80.9, 26.9], [-80.9, 27.2] ]); const targetDate = '2023-06-12'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for cyanobacteria detection let s2Col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeOkeechobee) .filterDate(targetDate, ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); const colSize = s2Col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images on ${targetDate}: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No Sentinel-2 data found for target date"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get best image and mask clouds const image = s2Col.first(); // Cloud masking using QA60 band const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); const maskedImage = image.updateMask(cloudMask); // 4. Cyanobacteria detection using NDCI (Normalized Difference Chlorophyll Index) const ndci = maskedImage.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDCI'); // Threshold for cyanobacteria detection (adjustable based on validation) const cyanobacteriaThreshold = 0.1; const cyanobacteriaMask = ndci.gt(cyanobacteriaThreshold); // 5. Calculate coverage statistics const cyanobacteriaStats = cyanobacteriaMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: lakeOkeechobee, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cyanPixels = cyanobacteriaStats.get('NDCI_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels = cyanobacteriaStats.get('NDCI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Cyanobacteria pixels: ${cyanPixels}`); console.log(`Total valid pixels: ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing"); console.log("C2"); return; } const coveragePercent = (cyanPixels / totalPixels) * 100; console.log(`Cyanobacteria coverage: ${coveragePercent.toFixed(2)}%`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (coveragePercent === null || coveragePercent === undefined || isNaN(coveragePercent) || coveragePercent < 0 || coveragePercent > 100) { console.log("C3"); } else if (coveragePercent > 30) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
